title: Join the AET Team!
introHtml:
American Education and Translation Services (AET) is a leading provider of translation, interpretation, and educational consulting services. We are always seeking talented professionals to join our dynamic team across our offices in Miami, Boston, New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Irvine.

At AET, we offer rewarding careers in education and translation services, providing opportunities for professional growth in a multicultural environment. Whether you're interested in translation, interpretation, credential evaluation, or business consulting, we have positions that match your skills and career goals.

Contact us to learn more about career opportunities!

jobs.title: Operation Research Analyst (Irvine, CA)
jobs.html:
AET is specialized in providing translation and various consulting services, and one branch office located in Irvine, CA. An Operation Research Analyst is sought to perform the following duties:

• Assess market trends, opportunities, and barriers to cryonics projects for Chinese nationals; devise and implement innovative strategies, programs, tools, and tactics to gain competitive edge for sales and drive growth.
• Implement statistical analysis for "Cryonics in China" project, via a nationwide questionnaire.
• Create sales reporting, analytics, and metrics as needed to assess sales performance and opportunities.
• Formulate and apply mathematical modeling for marketing strategy and financial analysis and evaluation of Cryonics project.
• Evaluate operational difficulties by collection and analysis of information and data, makes recommendations for problem solution.
• Analyze patient data and demographic information to perform business process analysis using statistical analysis, simulation, and optimization.
• Formulate and apply different statistical modeling strategies to develop and interpret information that assists management with decision making, policy formulation and other managerial functions.
• Analyze, design, formulate and implement business processes and procedures to reduce cost, improve efficient office workflow, identify business opportunities and loopholes, and provide suggestions for increasing profit margin.
• Provide recommendation to the office management on business process improvement projects, workflow efficiency, and patient satisfaction and retention programs.
• Maintain and supervise internal audits and auditing policy to decrease error and increase rectification process.

Required Skills and Qualities:
• Bachelor's degree in Mathematics or Statistics.
• Proficient in Python, MATLAB and Google Analytics.
• Strong research, analysis and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication skills.

Salary Information:
This is a full-time position. The salary is $ 59,821 per year.

Apply to American Education and Translation Services, Corp., 17802 Sky Park Cir, Suite 205 A, IRVINE, CA 92614-6403, United States.

Have the ability to work with local and remote development teams to get solutions developed and implemented.
Develop, document, and revise system design procedures, test procedures, and quality standards.
Review and analyze computer printouts and performance indicators to locate code problems and correct errors by correcting codes.

jobs.title: Medical Translator (Miami, FL)
jobs.html:
AET is specialized in providing translation and various consulting services, and one branch office located in Miami, FL. A Medical Translator is sought to perform the following duties:

1. Completely understand and precisely translate clients' documents from Chinese to English, and vice versa, such as medical reports, lab test reports, medical journals and other medical-related documents, taking into account differences with U.S. medical rules and customs and maintaining the main ideas and original meaning.
2. Translate medical company clients' promotional materials from Chinese to English, and vice versa, including but not limited to a series of business brochures, pamphlets, catalogs, promotional materials and the clients' company's website.
3. Translate English medical documents and marketing materials for the Chinese business markets.
4. Work together with Medical Research Analysts to prepare and translate medical consulting documents, including introduction documents, contracts, regulations and rules, etc. for our cryonics, surrogacy, and medical tourism and medical treatment clients.
5. Accompany our clients and provide translation services to participate in medical professional conferences, medical equipment exhibitions, doctor appointments.
6. Compile terminology and information to be used in translation of medical-related documents, including medical technology, medical sciences, and professional terms.
7. Research background material in related subjects to accurately translate difficult terms or highly technical languages.
8. Proofread and edit grammar, tone, and sentence structure of professional medical translation documents. Provide feedback on scientific papers, medical journals, and other medical terminology documents. Make sure all translations are accurate, remain consistent throughout translated documents and in accordance with the original meaning and medical industry cultures of relevant countries.
9. Proofread for grammar, tone and sentence structure, and provide feedback on scientific papers, medical documents, or other highly technical documents.
10. Identify and explain differences and conflicts related to the meanings of words, concepts, or practices between Western Medicine and Chinese Medicine.

Required Skills and Qualities:
1. Bachelor's degree in Medicine.
2. Proficient in Western Medicine and Chinese Medicine terminology.
3. Excellent oral and written skills in both Chinese and English.
4. Advanced computer skills, including Microsoft Office.

Apply to American Education and Translation Services, Corp., 15321 South Dixie Highway, Suite 302, Palmetto Bay, FL 33157.

jobs.html:

4) Plan and organize US Clinicians' teaching, seminar and presentation trips to China.

7) Research on China medical equipment industry's prevailing practices as well as market trends and new developments in order to drive growth & implement the most innovative strategies, programs, tools and tactics to gain competitive edge for our physician training and medical student exchange programs.
8) Provide statistical analyses and deliver research findings to the Management regarding the popularity, demand, and needs for certain medical training related services by distributing mass surveys and overseeing specific projects.
9) Research legal and industrial regulations in order to ensure company's compliance with laws in both China and US markets.

Minimum Requirements:

2) Two-year experience in medical product sales and related market consulting.
3) Track record of success in business consulting and medical product sales.
4) Familiar with China's drug market, medical equipment industry and doctor/hospital operation and practices.
5) Strong networking skills, excellent communication and persuasion skills.
6) Highly-motivated team member with ability to handle multi-tasks within deadlines.

To Apply:
Email your reusme and cover letter to info@aet21.com.

jobs.title: Education Counselor (Irvine Office, CA)
jobs.html:
AET is specialized in providing translation and various consulting services, and one branch office located in Irvine, CA. An Education Counselor is sought to perform the following duties:

• Provide information and advice to help demystify the U.S. high school and college admissions and scholarship or financial aid process.
• Assist students and parents in understanding the difference in techniques and strategies of educational exploration in the U.S. and Chinese high school and college admission process.
• Provide one-on-one advising to students (with parents or guardians) in areas of U.S. high school and college selection and applications, financial aid opportunities, college entrance examination encouragement, especially in Chemistry major.
• Assist students to assess and determine their educational needs and academic potential; assess student records, strengths and weaknesses.
• Assist students to set career goals in Chemistry industry and determine the necessary steps and the appropriate educational opportunity to achieve their goals.
• Guide students in their awareness and planning of their secondary school curriculum, including the selection of course of study or extracurricular activities that will enable them to maximize their educational and career potential.
• Assist students and parents in understanding the role of testing in U.S. education and the individual interpretation of all standardized test results.
• Inform clients on converting grades and calculate GPA of Chinese academic institutions into acceptable U.S. standards and vice versa.
• Broaden student's horizons by introducing them to the variety of U.S. postsecondary educational opportunities available and the educational routes to each, and plan campus visits when necessary.
• Review student's high school, college or graduate school applications; review students' essays in Chemistry major and provide feedback; prepare the students for school interviews.
• Guide the student to set his/her timeline of suggested tasks and important dates in the application process.
• Research and evaluate educational and credential systems of China and the U.S., including the educational institution's accreditation status and credential standard, especially in Chemistry major.
• Collect and analyze previous and existing clients' data in Chemistry major, monitor their career paths, forecast the trends in the study-abroad market, and report to the management on the updates.
• Examine the results of previous clients' performance at U.S. schools and suggest optimization in the current counseling services we provide.
• Review and analyze the chat record with clients and address the special needs of each client; prepare a guideline for the next counseling meeting with clients.

Job Requirements:
1. Must at least have a Bachelor's degree in Education, Chemistry Education or related fields;
2. Strong theory knowledge in Chemistry and experience in Education;
3. Advanced writing and oral communication skills.

Apply to American Education and Translation Services, Corp., 17802 Sky Park Cir, Suite 205 A, IRVINE, CA 92614-6403, United States.

jobs.title: Host Family
jobs.html:
Owing to huge expansion and a need for high quality families who can host overseas students in their homes, The American Education and Translation Service (AET) is seeking families, single parents, retired couples, and singles in Atlanta, Boston and Miami. These international students are mainly from China, who are from 15 to 18 years old.

Families must be open to other cultures and interested in the well-being of students. Hosting international students is an excellent way to build bridges in communication, understanding, and mutual respect with people from various ethnic backgrounds.

Families will be interviewed and screened carefully. Also, a home visit is done by AET to ensure that students will be comfortable in their surroundings. In addition, students are matched up with families based on the information provided by the students and host families. While rent is not provided, AET will make effort to reimburse costs for food, gas, utilities, etc.

Please email us at boston@aet21.com/info@aet21.com or call us with your interest and include your jobs, address, and family situation. We will reply to you soon!

apply.html:

2. Prepare your resume and cover letter tailored to the specific position.
3. Send your application materials to the specified email address for each position.
4. Include any relevant certifications, portfolios, or work samples as appropriate.

General Application Information:

• For Miami office positions: info@aet21.com
• For New York office positions: nyc@aet21.com
